title: Tighten a string field to a closed union without breaking the ratchet
prompt: In src/daemon/partySpawn.ts, the PARTY_BACK_AGENTS entries' `short` field is typed as plain `string` while every value is one of 'tank'|'dps1'|'dps2'|'dps3'. Tighten the field's type to that closed union (deriving from the seat field's PartySeat type where sensible), fix any resulting type errors in consumers WITHOUT weakening other types (no `any`, no assertions that erase the union), and keep the strict typecheck floor green: `bash scripts/typecheck/run-all.sh` must report no new breaks.
